id.description: Assigned by tooling on merge. Do not set manually.

version.description: Schema version this entry conforms to.

claim_type.description: The evidential category of the negative result. See schema/claim-types.md.

evidence_layer.description: The KIND of evidence, orthogonal to claim_type. A functional null and a binding positive are NOT contradictory. Critical for correct clustering/retrieval.

title.description: One-line summary of what was tested and not found.

observation.description: FREE TEXT. What was tested and what was (not) observed.

conditions.description: FREE TEXT. Parameters/conditions needed to interpret the null.

caveats.description: FREE TEXT. Self-assessed reasons the null might be an artifact.

alternatives.description: FREE TEXT. Suggested alternative approaches / future directions.

system.description: The experimental system. Fields optional but encouraged for filterability.

model.description: Cell line, strain, material, dataset, etc.

conditions_structured.description: Optional structured conditions to enable comparability checks. Free-text 'conditions' remains the fallback.

system.description: e.g. RRL, wheat-germ, HEK293T, 40 field sites

key_params.description: domain-specific: buffer, [Mg2+], dose range, temperature, season...

confidence.description: Makes the null interpretable. THE field most negative-results efforts omit.

level.description: Self-assessed strength of this negative result.

positive_control.description: Was the assay ever shown to detect a TRUE positive? A null from an assay never validated to detect anything is nearly uninterpretable.

present.description: Was a positive control / known-effect comparator run?

worked.description: Did that positive control produce the expected signal?

detail.description: What the positive control was and its result.

powered.description: Was the experiment adequately powered to detect a meaningful effect? (Interventional special case of 'threats to validity addressed'.)

controls.description: Controls used that support trusting the null.

n.description: Replicates / sample size, free-form to accommodate any design.

detection_limit.description: The threshold below which an effect could not have been seen.

related_positive.description: Known positive/contradicting results (DOIs, URLs, entry IDs). Prevents false consensus.

orcid.description: Strongly encouraged — ties credit to a persistent identifier.
